products.description:
The Kabuki Brush encourages a precise, seamless application.

For Standard: 

Dispense powder by removing the brush, twisting open the sifter, sealing the cap and shaking to loosen the powder.

Dip the brush into the powder and blend directly into the roots. Apply as desired.

For Travel: 

Lightly shake prior to use.

Section hair and apply the powder a 4–6 inches away from the root. Hold the nozzle closer for more targeted application.

Use your fingertips to massage it in for seamless blending without white cast

For Refill: 

Remove the empty component by twisting to the right, then recycle. Insert the new component at the base of the jar and twist to the left until it clicks into place.

products.overview: Matcha Boost Protein Hair Treatment — Matcha, Quinoa & Keratin | Ecoslay Matcha Boost is Ecoslay’s plant-based protein hair treatment — a targeted strengthening therapy for damaged, breakage-prone, and elasticity-depleted curls. Its triple-protein complex combines quinoa protein, keratin (from wheat and soy), and m
products.description:
Matcha Boost Protein Hair Treatment — Matcha, Quinoa & Keratin | Ecoslay
Matcha Boost is Ecoslay’s plant-based protein hair treatment — a targeted strengthening therapy for damaged, breakage-prone, and elasticity-depleted curls. Its triple-protein complex combines quinoa protein, keratin (from wheat and soy), and matcha leaf extract to rebuild the hair’s structure from the inside out. It fills microscopic gaps in the hair cuticle, restores elasticity, reduces shedding, and revives limp or over-conditioned curls — all without the stiffness of traditional protein treatments. This nutrient rich protein shake for your hair is handmade in small batches in Atlanta, GA. Works on all curl types from fine waves (2a) to thick coils (4c). .
What Matcha Boost Does For Your Hair:
When hair is damaged — by heat, color, chemical processing, or mechanical stress — it loses protein from microscopic gaps in the cuticle. These gaps cause breakage, loss of curl definition, reduced elasticity, and a limp, over-stretched texture that doesn’t spring back. Matcha Boost is formulated specifically to repair this damage.  
The hydrolyzed quinoa and keratin proteins penetrate the hair shaft and deposit into those gaps, rebuilding the natural protective layer. The result is visibly stronger hair with restored definition and shine. The matcha extract helps promote new growth and reduce shedding. Unlike many protein treatments that leave hair feeling stiff or brittle, Matcha Boost helps balance moisture and flexibility, ensuring curls come out soft and bouncy, not crunchy.

Rebuilds and strengthens damaged, brittle, breakage-prone hair 
Fills microscopic gaps in the hair cuticle for smooth, sealed strands 
Restores elasticity — curls spring back instead of stretching and snapping 
Revives limp, over-conditioned curls with protein-supported structure 
Increases the appearance of visibly fuller, thicker-looking hair 
Matcha helps stimulate follicle growth and reduce shedding 
Includes Keratin (wheat/soy-derived) Protein — no animal-derived ingredients 
Formulated to prevent the stiffness common in other protein treatments 
Safe for color-treated, chemically processed, and heat-damaged hair 
Vegan and cruelty-free
Kid-friendly formula

Ingredients:
Distilled Water, Cetearyl Alcohol, Behentrimonium Methosulfate, Hydrolyzed Quinoa Protein, Hydrolyzed Keratin, Matcha Extract, Propanediol, HP Starch, Preservation Blend.
Best For:

Wavy (2a–2c)  
Curly (3a–3c)  
Coily (4a–4c)  
Dry, damaged, breakage-prone hair
Kids & adults

How to Use:
Apply based on hair damage level and diameter. Your usage requirements will vary depending on your level of damage, maintenance goals and hair diameter. Please refer to the usage table under "How to Use". Rinse thoroughly after use.
It can be purchased with a 16 oz reusable plastic mason jar and pump top.

products.description:
Rice Pudding Leave-In Conditioner & Moisturizer — Fermented Rice Water & Marshmallow Root | Ecoslay
Rice Pudding is Ecoslay’s leave-in conditioner and daily moisturizer — a lightweight, plant-based formula made with fermented rice water and nine farm-grown botanical extracts including marshmallow root, chamomile, slippery elm, horsetail, nettle, and peppermint. It strengthens strands, adds brilliant shine, softens curls, and provides excellent detangling slip without any heaviness or buildup. Made without silicones, free of harsh preservatives, and handmade in small batches in Atlanta, GA, and packaged in eco-friendly pouches and refillable glass mason jars. Works on all curl types and is especially loved by those with fine, low-porosity, or wavy hair. 

 What Rice Pudding Does For Your Hair:
Rice Pudding is the step between conditioning and styling — the product that preps your curls for definition, seals in moisture post-wash, and keeps hair soft and manageable between wash days. The fermented rice water strengthens each strand and smooths the cuticle for high-gloss shine. The marshmallow root and slippery elm deliver exceptional detangling slip with zero stiffness. The botanical herbal blend — chamomile, horsetail, nettle, melissa, peppermint, and yucca — nourishes the scalp, fights dandruff, and promotes healthy hair growth from root to tip. Unlike heavier creams, Rice Pudding absorbs into the hair rather than sitting on top of it, making it the ideal leave-in for fine, normal, and low-porosity curl types. 

Strengthens strands and reduces breakage with fermented rice water amino acids 
Adds brilliant, high-gloss shine without product buildup or greasiness 
Detangles with exceptional slip from marshmallow root and slippery elm 
Lightweight formula that absorbs fully — no heaviness, no weighing curls down 
Defines and softens curls for multi-day moisture retention 
Nourishes the scalp with 9 botanicals: chamomile, horsetail, nettle, melissa, peppermint, yucca, slippery elm, and more 
Promotes healthy hair growth and fights dandruff and scalp buildup 
Safe for color-treated, chemically processed, and transitioning hair 
No silicones, no parabens, no harsh synthetic preservatives
Kid-friendly 

Ingredients:

Water, marshmallow root extract, fermented rice water, chamomile flower extract, slippery elm extract, nettle leaf extract, melissa leaf extract, peppermint leaf extract, horsetail leaf extract, yucca vera leaf extract

Best For:

Wavy (2a–2c)  
Curly (3a–3c)  
Coily (4a–4c)  
Fine hair
Low to normal-porosity hair
Kids & adults

products.name: IGK Rich Kid Cream
products.overview: Shop Rich Kid Coconut Oil Gel - Air Dry Stylery at IGK Hair! Free Shipping*, 20% OFF First order
products.description:
For fine hair – start with a small amount and build up as needed

Straight or lightly wavy hair:

Air Dry:

Rub product between palms and over fingers.
When hair is almost dry, finger comb in from mid-lengths to ends.
Let hair air dry for easy, tousled texture.
For frizz-free waves, twist the hair in small sections and let the hair air dry. As hair dries, the twists will unravel and leave hair with a wavy texture.

Blow Dry:

Rub product between palms.
When hair is almost dry, run product from mid-lengths to ends.
Blow dry in for style memory, shine and frizz-control.

Curly hair:

Air Dry or Diffuse:

Start with Good Behavior 4-in-1 Prep Spray for extra definition.
Towel dry hair with a t-shirt or cotton towel. Be careful not to rub and cause frizz.
Mix Rich Kid Coconut Oil Air Dry Styler. For added moisture mix with Mistress Hydrating Hair Balm.
When hair is about 75% dry, work the mixture through hair, twisting and scrunching to encourage your natural texture.

Extra Tips:

For short hair or all-over hold – apply to damp hair and work from roots to ends. Will give a soft hold with shine.
For a piecey beach wave look or creating texture in a blowout – apply to your fingertips and brush lightly through the hair.
Apply just to ends for a detailed, piecey finish.
